meta.name: liger-kernel-dev
meta.description: Develops production-ready Triton kernels for Liger Kernel. Creates new kernels from PyTorch operations (local files, URLs, code snippets, or natural language) with ops, module wrappers, functional APIs, unit tests, benchmarks, and plots. Also modifies existing Liger kernels. Use when adding a new Triton kernel, converting a PyTorch operation to Triton, or updating an existing Liger kernel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从 PyTorch 操作创建生产级 Triton 内核
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常编写或优化高性能 Triton 内核。
copy.tagline_en: Create production-level Triton kernels from PyTorch operations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently write or optimize high-performance Triton kernels.

howto.what: Claude可以帮你为Liger Kernel开发高效的Triton内核。它能从你提供的PyTorch代码（文件、网址、代码片段或描述）自动生成完整的Triton内核，包括操作、模块封装、函数API、测试和基准测试。也可以修改已有的内核。需要NVIDIA GPU。
howto.when: 当你要求创建新的Triton内核（如说“生成内核”、“添加内核”）或修改现有Liger内核（如“更新内核”、“修复内核”）时触发。

say.text: 帮我从这段PyTorch代码生成Triton内核。
say.note: Claude会解析代码并创建完整的内核文件。

say.text: 修改Liger Kernel中的layer_norm内核，支持float16。
say.note: Claude会修改对应文件并验证。

say.text: 为我的自定义操作创建一个新的Liger内核。
say.note: 需要提供操作描述或代码片段。

howto.what_en: Claude can develop production-ready Triton kernels for Liger Kernel from PyTorch operations (files, URLs, code, or description), generating ops, wrappers, APIs, tests, benchmarks, and plots. It can also modify existing kernels. Requires NVIDIA GPU.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a new Triton kernel (from PyTorch code, snippet, natural language) or modify an existing Liger kernel (update, fix, change, extend).

say_en.text: Generate a Triton kernel from this PyTorch code.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes and produces the full kernel files.

say_en.text: Modify the layer_norm kernel to support float16.
say_en.note: Claude updates the kernel and runs validation.

say_en.text: Create a new Liger kernel for my custom operation.
say_en.note: Provide description or code for the operation.
